what_it_is: Intermediate catheter engineered for stroke intervention with TruCourse Technology for smoother navigation. Features 55cm hydrophilic coating, 1:1 responsiveness, angle cut polymer jacket for smooth transitions, and improved lumen integrity during intra-procedural use.
sizing_specs: Usable Length: 115 cm; Product codes: EVT110, NIC71115U, NIC71132U, NIC71137U; Compatible with base catheters >= 0.085 inch ID
indications: Optimized for effective direct aspiration and up to 3 stent retriever passes. Designed for acute ischemic stroke intervention.
compatible_with: EMBOTRAP III Revascularization Device, EMBOGUARD Balloon Guide Catheter, CEREBASE DA Guide Sheath, Prowler EX Microcatheter (CERENOVUS Stroke Solutions system)
use_notes: More trackable than Sofia Plus, React 71, Catalyst 6, and Large Bore Catheter. Lower track forces than Zoom 71. More kink-resistant during intra-procedural use than Sofia Plus and React 71. Larger inner diameter than Sofia Plus, Catalyst 6, Catalyst 7, React 68.
